We need to debug why the canvas appears blank. The initial implementation is incomplete. The user tasks have asked to gradually build a game, but the assistant only implemented a small set of functions so far. They haven't yet added update logic, player movement, hazard spawning, rendering background/hazards/player. So the canvas is blank (only background color set by CSS on canvas). The instructions: "the page was loaded in a real browser and one or more checks did not pass". The canvas appears blank (only one color). Means that our render may not draw anything beyond the score text perhaps. At the moment render draws only the score text (which may show but the background is still plain black). The validator may consider it a blank canvas because not drawing hazards or player; they might expect some initial drawing. But according to the tasks, we haven't completed hazard rendering, player drawing, etc. The tasks only up to 12, but we haven't completed those tasks beyond UI. Let's see tasks list: our eventual tasks up to 12 include audio integration, but we haven't implemented many earlier things: Player movement, Hazards system, etc. Actually we haven't created those functions. We only set placeholders for player and hazards, but haven't implemented spawn, update, and rendering. Also haven't included reset initialization, start loop call, input handling, etc. Let's examine current index.html for missing sections: They only have CONFIG, STATE, LOOP, RENDER, plus hazard config constants. No input handling, player movement, hazard system, collision detection, scoring increments, game over overlay present but not called, observable contract function is defined earlier with publishState call. But we haven't defined update() function, render() draws only score and overlay. Also no startLoop() call at the end of script; no reset function defined. So nothing is happening.

The validation expects a full game that draws something. However the instruction says tasks 2-12 must be implemented step-by-step following task list. The assistant has done tasks 1-12 but incomplete earlier tasks: I suspect we missed tasks 2-12 partially. The instructions: "Now do task 2 of 12: Game State Objects — Define player, hazards, score, and phase objects at top of script with initial values." The assistant added snapshot. Task 3: Animation loop — implemented startLoop, but hasn't called it. Task 4: Input handling — not yet added. Actually we haven't done task 4. Wait, earlier we had removed input handling attempt?
